{{infobox Qwen3.5 (small sizes)
Developer: Alibaba Qwen
Sizes: 0.8B, 2B, 4B, 9B (each with a -Base)
Architecture: Gated DeltaNet hybrid, vision-language
Context: 262K
License: Apache-2.0
Role here: First experiments}}

The '''Qwen3.5''' small models are the current sub-10B Qwen line. There are no sub-10B Qwen3.6 or Qwen3.8 models.<ref>[https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B Qwen3.5-4B model card]</ref>

== In this project ==
* TRL's BrowserGym GRPO example uses '''Qwen3.5-2B''' by default, the shortest path to a working browser RL run.<ref>[https://github.com/huggingface/trl/tree/main/examples/grpo_browsergym TRL grpo_browsergym example]</ref>
* '''Qwen3.5-4B''' is a good first real target: a 150-step run is about 3.7 days on one [[dgx-spark|Spark]] or about 35 hours on four (estimates, see [[run-time]]).
* Unsloth's guide says Qwen3.5-architecture models need <code>fast_inference=False</code>, which makes rollouts slower in Unsloth.<ref>[https://unsloth.ai/docs/get-started/reinforcement-learning-rl-guide Unsloth RL guide]</ref>
* The same architecture as [[qwen3-8-27b|Qwen3.8-27B]], so what works at 4B should carry over.
